data.title: Coop+ Subscription Platform
data.description: Led front-end development of Coop+, Knowledge Coop's subscription product for mortgage professionals. Owned the UI overhaul (brand colors, typography, spacing, and a full responsive pass), redesigned the course landing page and carousel navigation, built community features such as member lists and full community descriptions, and shipped a steady stream of production fixes across membership, checkout, and continuing-education workflows.
highlights: Applied the updated brand system across the app: colors, typography, spacing, and a site-wide responsive rollout for mobile breakpoints.
Redesigned the course landing page and rebuilt carousel arrow navigation for a cleaner browsing experience.
Added community features: view all members of a community and read full community descriptions from the discovery page.
Built a continuing-education countdown timer and tightened CTA copy for add/remove/upgrade actions.
Resolved high-priority production issues including membership modal flows, re-subscription failures, logout errors, blurry course covers, and broken topic links.
Adjusted Coop AI query limits so subscribers receive unlimited use (per product spec), backed by a database audit of remaining free-tier credits.
30+ stories, tasks, and bug fixes shipped across my first year.

data.title: Design System & Component Library
data.description: Contributed to a growing shared component library for Knowledge Coop's next-generation platform from Figma specs — Alert, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumbs, Card, Drawer, File Upload, Modal, Pagination, Tag, Toast, Toggle, Tooltip, Cascading Dropdown Menu, and more — with token-driven styling, well-defined variants, and accessibility baked in from the start.
highlights: Delivered 23 components and variants, every one taken from Figma spec to production-ready code.
Migrated borders, spacing, and color to design tokens so components restyle from a single source of truth.
Designed variant systems for a table and its cells (with 10+ variants) in addition to a cascading list-item pattern used to display hierarchical data in a menu.
Added error, empty, and removable states (File Upload error styling, Avatar remove action) to round out real-world usage.
Implemented Toast Component and Global System for Next-Gen platform.

data.title: Next-Gen Learning Platform Rebuild
data.description: Founding developer on the ground-up rebuild of Knowledge Coop's learning platform. Delivered the Library content upload functionality (file rename, archive, publishing, save-as-draft, location and section pickers, display cards), side navigation for Content Manager and Courses, and the Courses module covering create, manage, filter and sort, archive, and delete.
highlights: Library: rename files before publishing, archive resources, publish immediately or save as draft, and select a destination location and section.
Display cards for library content, built on the shared design-system Card component.
Side navigation for the Content Manager and Courses areas.
Courses: create, manage, filter and sort, archive, and delete flows for platform.
14 user stories across the Library, Content Manager, and Courses epics with more on the horizon.

data.title: Billing & Payments Integration
data.description: Owned Stripe and billing work across Knowledge Coop's legacy and subscription stacks: Stripe-hosted checkout, a Billing Portal for card management, webhook hardening for failure cases, email and receipt sync, seat-tier pricing, and an internal 'Billing Utopia' integration that produces QuickBooks-ready invoicing exports for the finance team.
highlights: Integrated Stripe-hosted checkout for subscription sign-up and launched the Stripe Billing Portal for self-service card management.
Hardened webhook handling so failed events are not re-run, and fixed renewal emails that linked customers to the wrong destination.
Kept customer email changes in sync with Stripe so receipts reach the right inbox after reported incidents.
Added seat-tier pricing to the seat-management feature.
Researched and built the Billing Utopia integration, generating QuickBooks invoices via api integration with supporting csv data.

data.title: Auth, Accounts & Platform Reliability
data.description: Kept a multi-tenant Django learning platform healthy for enterprise customers. Fixed an admin-approval sign-up bypass, password-reset and social-auth exceptions, login and registration redirect flows, subscription-end access revocation, account-merge tooling, duplicate-charge and duplicate-record bugs, analytics tracking, and app-store developer-account compliance.
highlights: Closed a security gap that let users self-register while 'sign-ups must be approved by admins' was enabled.
Fixed password-reset and social-authentication exceptions affecting new logins.
Preserved redirect targets across login, registration, and verification emails so users land where they intended.
Automatically revoke group and role access when a subscription ends.
Maintained internal account-merge and content-ownership scripts used by the support team.
Resolved data-integrity bugs (duplicate records) and restored Google Tag Manager tracking with enhanced-conversion data-layer variables.
Handled Google Play developer-account compliance to keep the mobile listing active.

data.title: Golf Drill Challenge
data.description: The Golf Drill Challenge is a cross-platform mobile application that aims to assist in golf training. It accomplishes this through drill management for coaches, plan distribution for practices, individual drill assignments for players, and team leaderboards to encourage healthy competition. On top of this, player progress is tracked over time on a graphical interface to allow for further insights into player performance. All in all, the Golf Drill Challenge App attempts to bring a digital approach to the training process of golf teams everywhere.

data.title: Fight The Night
data.description: "Fight the Night" is a 2D pixel art action-platformer developed for a themed game jam centered around "Cycles." Leading the project, I created a detailed development roadmap and managed tight timelines, demonstrating adaptability and efficiency. The result is a polished game experience delivered within the constraints of the game jam.

data.title: ASOSU Website
data.description: In my time with ASOSU, I enhanced the organization's website through its design and functionality in order to improve user experience and accessibility. This involved leading the migration from Drupal 7 to Drupal 10 as the former was reaching its end of lifecycle. In my time with the website, my efforts contributed to ensuring a user-friendly and modern online presence by redesigning, maintaining, and refactoring the website often.

data.title: Testing Suite for a Graph Creation Application
data.description: This project involved creating a testing suite for an application, which enables users to create line charts, scatter plots, and bar charts effortlessly, focuses on ensuring robust functionality and user satisfaction. The testing strategy encompasses comprehensive unit testing to validate data input and chart generation processes, integration testing to confirm seamless interaction with the API, and end-to-end testing to simulate user flows and validate gallery-saving functionalities.

data.title: Weather Mobile Application
data.description: My Weather mobile application provides users with real-time weather updates in a responsive and visually appealing interface. Developed using Kotlin, the application ensures efficient and scalable performance on android devices. By integrating the OpenWeather API, users can easily retrieve and view current weather conditions for their specified cities, making it a reliable tool for staying informed about weather changes.

data.title: DraftTime - Web App
data.description: DraftTime is a web-based application designed for fantasy football enthusiasts. Users can draft their fantasy football team from a randomly generated roster provided by the application. They will then compete against other users in a head-to-head format, aiming to achieve a perfect 17-0 season based on the fantasy scores of the players on their team. A proof of concept was created in winter of 2023 for a class project. Design work then picked up again in Summer of 2024 though advancement has come to a halt due to unforeseen costs in sport data collection.

data.title: Python FTP Server
data.description: The Python FTP Server project aims to develop a robust, efficient, and user-friendly File Transfer Protocol (FTP) server using Python. This server will facilitate secure and reliable file transfers between clients and the server, catering to a wide range of use cases from personal file storage to enterprise-level data management. This Project was instrumental to improving my knowledge of networking.

data.title: Tarpaulin API
data.description: The Tarpaulin API is designed and implemented to be a lightweight course management tool that serves as an alternative to Canvas. Tarpaulin enables instructors and students to view course information, manage assignments, and submit solutions.

data.title: MST Implementation
data.description: My Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) Implementation in C++ delivers an efficient solution for finding the MST of a given graph. Utilizing advanced algorithms, the implementation ensures optimal performance and reliability, making it a valuable tool for applications requiring efficient network design and connectivity solutions.
